hero.title: Events & Calendar
hero.subtitle: Join our vibrant community events, parent workshops, and celebration days.

sections.title: Connecting Families Through Joyful Campus Gatherings
sections.subtitle: Parent participation and community joy are at the heart of our school life.
sections.content:
Throughout the academic year, Star Kids hosts an exciting calendar of family carnivals, seasonal science expos, junior sports tournaments, and parenting workshops.

Events are open to current families, alumni, and prospective parents seeking to discover our campus culture.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Events
sections.subtitle: Details regarding guests, ticketing, parking, and photography.

items.question: Can prospective parents attend Star Kids events?
items.answer: Yes! Community festivals, workshops, and science fairs are open to all families with advance RSVP.

items.question: Is parking available on campus for large events?
items.answer: Yes, our main visitor parking and adjacent designated overflow lot provide ample complimentary parking.
